name: Panderr – Website Migration
author: panderr

sections.description:
Panderr helps website owners move an existing website while keeping the content, structure, and identity they already have.

The plugin adds a Panderr migration screen inside WordPress and detects the current website URL and website name. From there, administrators can continue the website migration workflow on Panderr.

Panderr supports three website migration approaches:

  • Preserve — move the existing website while retaining its current design and content as closely as possible.
  • Improve — keep the existing identity and content while improving the website.
  • Redesign — use the existing website as the starting point for a new design.

The plugin is intended for website administrators who want to move, improve, or redesign an existing WordPress website through the Panderr service.

External Services

This plugin connects to the external Panderr service at https://panderr.com/.

When an administrator clicks “Continue with Panderr”, the plugin opens Panderr in a new browser tab and sends the following information as URL parameters:

  • The public URL of the WordPress website.
  • The WordPress website name.
  • A source value identifying WordPress as the originating platform.

This information is sent only when the administrator explicitly clicks the “Continue with Panderr” button.

Panderr’s service is required to continue the migration workflow.

Panderr Privacy Policy:
https://panderr.com/privacy/

Panderr Terms of Service:
https://panderr.com/terms/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the panderr-migration folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin ZIP through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Open Panderr from the WordPress admin menu.
  4. Review the detected website information.
  5. Click “Continue with Panderr” to begin the migration workflow.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin automatically change my WordPress website?

No. The plugin does not modify your website content, theme, plugins, or database.

What information is sent to Panderr?

When you choose to continue, the plugin sends your website’s public URL and website name to Panderr so the migration workflow can begin.

Do I need a Panderr account?

A Panderr account may be required to continue or save a migration project on Panderr.

Does activating the plugin send data automatically?

No. Website information is sent only after an administrator clicks the “Continue with Panderr” button.
